notes: SPAD in src/SPAD.sol has no constructor arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. It has no administrative powers, public mint or burn functions, transfer taxes, or initialization calls. No application contracts are included. The pool uses the specified ERC-20 paired currency, a 0.3% fee, and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with SPAD as currency0 and the paired currency as currency1 in minor units. The deployer derives the actual opening price from the supplied economics and total supply using the deployed currency address order.
